explanation: EXCLURAD requires Q2 to be the positive magnitude of the spacelike virtuality (Q2 = -q^2 > 0). The requested Q2 = -0.5 GeV^2 therefore fails preflight and also lies outside the eta lookup-table Q2 grid [0, 5] GeV^2. No input file was generated because changing the request to Q2 = +0.5 GeV^2 would require confirmation that the supplied negative value was q^2 rather than EXCLURAD's Q2 convention.
